title: PUT vs PATCH trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for put-vs-patch trace events.

path.description: The URL of the single resource this run works on.

exists.description: Whether anything is stored at that URL right now.

etag.description: Entity tag of the stored representation ('v2'); empty while the resource is absent.

document.description: The stored representation, one entry per surviving field.

status.description: How the current request touched this field: created it, gave it a new value, rewrote the same value, or never mentioned it.

removed.description: Fields the current request took away, with the value they held before.

request.description: The request being processed (absent before the first one).

kind.description: What the body means: a complete representation, a merge patch document, or a list of operations.

ifMatch.description: The If-Match precondition the client sent, or null for an unconditional write.

body.description: The body as sent; a null value is a real JSON null.

response.description: The answer the server produced for the current request.

status.description: HTTP status line ('200 OK', '404 Not Found'), or 'pending' while the request is still being processed.

applied.description: Whether the request actually reached the stored representation.

requests.description: How many requests the client has sent so far.

fieldsWiped.description: Fields deleted only because a PUT body omitted them.
